description: Rothco’s Solar Wind-Up Flashlight with Radio is your go-to tool for reliable light and communication in any situation. Whether you’re camping, facing a power outage, or simply enjoying the outdoors, this versatile survival device ensures you’re never left in the dark. The camping flashlight features 5 bright LED lights powered by either solar energy or manual cranking, giving you the flexibility to charge it wherever you are. With just one minute of cranking, you can enjoy up to 25 minutes of flashlight use or 6 minutes of radio time. The built-in AM/FM radio keeps you connected to important news and updates, while the compact and lightweight design makes it easy to carry in your gear or emergency kit. This multi-functional flashlight is an essential addition to your emergency preparedness tools and survival gear, offering peace of mind when you need it most.
